description: A local-services vendor sells to commercial HVAC contractors in the United States. The qualifying account is a commercial HVAC contractor with 20 to 200 staff, headquartered or operating in Texas, Florida, or Georgia. Excluded are residential-only HVAC contractors, equipment manufacturers and distributors, and general trade contractors that do not run HVAC as a distinct line of business.

buyer.rubric: The positive buyer is the owner or operations leader who owns the budget for the business: Owner, President, General Manager, VP of Operations, or Director of Operations. Influencers who shape but do not own the purchase include field service managers and dispatch leads, who surface operational pain but do not control spend. Hard negatives are field technicians and installers with no budget authority.

requirements.text: The company is a commercial HVAC contractor with 20 to 200 staff.
The company is headquartered or operates in Texas, Florida, or Georgia.
The company does commercial HVAC work as a distinct line of business, not residential-only service, equipment manufacturing, or distribution.
